# AscentRoam

> AscentRoam (登攀) is an offline high-altitude mountaineering and trekking curriculum for Android. Learning progress is expressed as altitude: 3,200 m at the start, 8,848 m at the end of the route.

## What it contains
- 91 lessons in 10 units: 6 alpine units (69 lessons) and 4 trekking units (22 lessons)
- 1,563 questions in 8 formats, with spaced review (0/1/3/7/16/35 days)
- 35 long-form field notes, filtered by track
- 40 achievements, each a real-time 3D badge
- 38 target peaks and routes: 30 alpine peaks up to all fourteen 8,000ers, 8 trekking routes
- 10 languages: zh-CN, zh-TW, en, ja, de, fr, es, it, ru, sv
- Fully offline; no account required

## Limits
The app covers theory and awareness only. It is not a guide, not medical advice, and not a guarantee of a summit. Ice, rope, climbing and rescue skills require a certified instructor and supervised field practice.
